# Marymount School of New York

> Marymount is a premier independent Catholic all-girls private school in NYC offering rigorous academics, arts innovation, and Catholic values across Lower, Middle, and Upper School divisions.

Founded with roots in the RSHM global community and the legacy of Mother Marie Joseph Butler, Marymount serves students from Nursery through Grade 12 across two Upper East Side campuses. The school emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and financial accessibility through merit scholarships and aid programs.

- [Lower School Admissions (N-V)](https://www.marymountnyc.org/admissions/n-v-admissions): Admissions information and timeline for Nursery through Elementary School at Marymount
- [Middle & High School Admissions (VI-XII)](https://www.marymountnyc.org/admissions/vi-xii-admissions): Admissions process and requirements for middle and high school at Marymount
- [Tuition & Financial Aid](https://www.marymountnyc.org/admissions/tuition-affordability): Tuition costs, financial aid options, and payment plans for Marymount
- [Butler Scholars Program](https://www.marymountnyc.org/admissions/butler-scholars): Merit-based Butler Scholars scholarship program for Marymount Upper School
